info.title: Mindstrata API
info.description: Проверяемый контракт Go API. Поле x-router-path связывает OpenAPI path с регистрацией mux.HandleFunc в apps/api/internal/httpapi/router.go.

get.description: Machine-readable export of all data held about the caller (GDPR art. 15/20, 152-FZ art. 14). Always the session owner; a userId query parameter is ignored.
Consent journal of the caller (logged-in user or guest).

post.description: Record an act of consent: document, version and SHA-256 of the displayed text.
Withdraw every active consent for a document; takes effect on the next AI call.

requestBody.description: multipart/form-data with file and optional scope

get.description: Installation data-protection profile, declared storage country, warnings and gateway processing countries. Owner/admin only.

post.description: Set the ISO country where an AI gateway processes data.

get.description: Who opened personal data (dialogs, user cards, exports). Ids only, never message text. Owner/admin only.
